name: Okasare Yuusha III ~Yuusha na no ni, Binkan Sugiru Boku no Ochinchin...~
original_name: 犯され勇者Ⅲ～勇者なのに、ビンカンすぎるボクのおちんちん…～
source:
The Empress suddenly assigned you to put down the strong monster, Kyuubi (the nine-tailed fox). Being a fresh and new exorcist, you try hard to meet their expectations; however, dreadful yet sensual monster girls take advantage of your lack of experience and assault you sexually without a break!
Can you defeat the powerful monsters to save the world? Or will your mission fail and after which, you go to the heaven in ecstasy?
translation:
女皇突然命你去讨伐强大的妖怪九尾狐。作为初出茅庐的驱魔师，你一心想不负期待，可那些美艳而可怕的魔物娘却抓住你缺乏经验的弱点，对你展开一波又一波的性侵犯！

你能战胜强敌、拯救世界吗？还是会任务失败，在极乐中升天？
